items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: I used to have to hold him when he was teaching them.

ctx.x: You were going to tell us about another older group that he taught too.

That was before my time, you see. I was around ten years old. I was just after my mother died. And I started waiting in that grocery place I was telling you about. And all of them used to gather there. The man we worked was a very good man. He always had a bunch of behind the very nice to cover people. And those boys got together and organized a band. And I think he paid for all the instruments, you know. That was twelve of them. I think he gave them all the instruments. They used to be at his place. But he used…
I hauled them the same way. I was joined then, I was in my 20s. I was over 20 when I started.
